decisions.reason: Product B is now the firm's only archiving and reporting software after A was withdrawn, so it carries that option, but its low visibility and missing evidence since 2019 leave real doubt about its value even though software is cheap to maintain.
The manhole floor door with safety railing is a low-cost hardware extension with its own page that meets lasting safety needs of municipal water operators, so keeping the option open costs little.
The floating sludge extractor fits the tank equipment line, and long infrastructure sales cycles mean its value is still unresolved at modest holding cost.
Control technology for water engineering machinery supports the firm's move toward connected, data-driven automation and complements its machinery, so it has strategic value at low cost.

Flow measurement automation software has its own page, is close to the core offer, and fits the data-driven direction, and too little evidence has arrived since its 2019 launch to justify abandoning it.
